crispdm.name: Business Understanding
crispdm.summary: Identify key profitability drivers for 50 startups to optimize investment allocation and venture capital evaluation.

crispdm.name: Data Understanding
crispdm.summary: Exploratory analysis on 50 startup records across 3 spending categories and 3 US states. No missing values or duplicates found.

crispdm.name: Data Preparation
crispdm.summary: Train/Test split (80/20, random_state=42). Dummy encoding on State column using drop='first' to avoid dummy variable trap.

crispdm.name: Modeling
crispdm.summary: Trained baseline OLS and 5 distinct feature selection methods (LassoCV, RFECV, SFS, ElasticNetCV, Exhaustive).

crispdm.name: Evaluation
crispdm.summary: Assessed models on 5-fold CV RMSE and out-of-sample Test RMSE/R2. 4 methods converged on identical 3-feature subset.

crispdm.name: Deployment
crispdm.summary: Interactive Geek / AI Research Lab Dashboard MVP for exploring models, feature selections, and prediction diagnostics.

models.name: Baseline OLS
models.description: Standard multiple linear regression fitted on all 5 available features without variable elimination.

models.name: LassoCV
models.description: Applies an L1 penalty on standardized features to shrink non-essential regression coefficients strictly to zero.

models.name: RFECV
models.description: Iteratively trains estimators and prunes the least contributing feature based on coefficient weights.
models.note: RFECV retained all five encoded features in this run; this observation alone does not establish why the selection occurred.

models.name: Sequential Forward Selection
models.description: Starts with an empty feature set and greedily adds the feature that yields the maximum CV RMSE reduction at each step.

models.name: ElasticNetCV
models.description: Combines L1 sparsity with L2 shrinkage across multiple l1_ratio hyperparameter candidates.

models.name: Exhaustive Feature Selection
models.description: Evaluates all 31 non-empty feature combinations via 5-fold CV to mathematically guarantee the global minimum CV error.
